question: Does wither apply to the damage Hateflayer deals with its activated ability, as well as to its combat damage?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: wither applies to any damage Hateflayer deals to a creature.
expected.answer: Wither applies to any damage Hateflayer deals to a creature, which includes both its combat damage and damage from its activated ability.
